title: TrackSearch: a late My likes page overwrites Saved playlists
acceptance: Switching TrackSearch from My likes to Saved playlists (or opening a playlist) invalidates any likes request still in flight, so a late likes page cannot replace the playlists view's rows or clear its error, loading or reconnect state.
A test starts a slow likes first page, switches to Saved playlists, resolves the page, and expects the playlists view unchanged.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-23) at the close of round 1123 from #790's final reviews. Pre-existing on main before #790 and not worsened by it. Backlog until the owner sets Ready. Likely a one-line fix: bump reqId before the saved_playlists early return in apps/web/src/components/TrackSearch.tsx (about line 450 on main ff651a1).

evidence.summary: #790's fresh-context final review at de859ea, note 1 (pre-existing): saved_playlists returns before ++reqId.current, so a likes first page still loading lands after the switch and writes liked songs into the playlists view, clearing error, libraryErrorCode and searching.
